correctness.rationale: With \(B=\beta/(2\chi)\), \(E=e^{-\mu}\), and \(y=e^\alpha\), the source expression reduces to \(R_1=BE[1+p(y-1-E)]/[(y-E)(1-pE)]\). Direct differentiation gives \(\partial R_1/\partial p=BE(y-1)/[(y-E)(1-pE)^2]>0\) and \(\partial R_1/\partial y=BE(p-1)/[(1-pE)(y-E)^2]\le0\). Solving \(R_1=1\) gives the displayed \(p_c(\alpha)\); its endpoint condition is \(\alpha_\star=\log(E(1+B))\), and its limit is \(1/[E(1+B)]\). Independent symbolic algebra reproduced these identities and the source numerical thresholds \(p\approx0.6768\) at \(\alpha=0.03\) and \(\alpha\approx0.0362\) at \(p=0.8\).
